name: LINEMARKING_VEHICLE_WIDTH_MARKER_{side}_WHITE_TALL
notes: TfNSW plan T6-232-1n (Roads & Maritime 2019 sheet): width marker panel for articulated linemarking vehicles (attached to the mudguard), 150 x 450, R20, double sided, hinged to the vehicle; white with black 45-degree stripes and a thin black outline as the sheet draws it (keyline). Stripes from the stripe detail (25 / 54 / 54 / 54 square to the stripes from the upper outer corner): the corner band is black to 79 (25 + 54, as drawn), then 54 white / 54 black alternately. The sheet draws an OFF SIDE pair and a NEAR SIDE pair (mirror images); (R) is the off-side (driver's side) panel as dimensioned, stripes falling to the left, and (L) the near-side panel, its mirror image. The mounting brackets, mirror and mudguard outlines on the sheet are not part of the marker.
